text:
Alex (Marketing): Heads up — finalizing a one-pager + benchmark post for the enterprise launch next Wed. Primary focus: security, SLAs, and deployment modes. Need headline messaging, webinar tie-in, and inbound routing rules.
Rita (Field): Love it. Can we lead with the economic case (cost/latency) + SLA commitments? Field needs a one-page decision matrix they can use in calls.
Sam (Product): Agree on economic framing. For the benchmark narrative we should call out: '~40% per-token cost reduction vs naive self-hosting' and 'p50 latency < 120ms for 2k token streams' — will pull numbers from infra. Need infra signoff on wording.
Noah (Growth): I'll draft the launch post and the webinar CTA. Routing suggestion: 1) Webinar/signup form -> qualification question: "Company size" and "Security/regulatory needs" 2) Enterprise-tagged leads -> AE queue + Slack alert to #ae-inbound 3) Regulated/gov leads -> security-specialists flow with dedicated follow-up. Also recommend early-access invite for Dedicated.
Priya (Solutions): Content checklist for the one-pager: hero stat, 3 bullets (problem we solve, how Redwood solves it, enterprise benefits), a tiny deploy-modes diagram (Hosted / Dedicated / Private), compliance badges (SOC2/ISO), and 2 CTAs: Book demo + Join webinar.
Sam (Product): Would like a tiny code example to show API parity across modes, something like: ```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"model":"rw-large-1","input":"Summarize..."}'
``` keeps devs comfortable.
Rita (Field): @Noah for HubSpot routing: can we set lead scoring rule token usage estimate > 1M/mo -> high intent and tag 'private-deploy-prospect'? Field wants the tag added automatically.
launch-bot: Webinar slot confirmed: Thu 11am PT. Slide deck due Tue EOD. Recording will be auto-posted to /marketing/blog and the demo team gets the recording for follow-ups.
Alex (Marketing): Ownership roundup: Alex — messaging + one-pager draft; Noah — launch post + routing rules; Priya — collateral checklist + compliance assets; Sam — benchmark writeup + perf numbers; Rita — field one-pager vet + AE play. Reconvene Mon 10am for final review. I'll post a first draft by COB today. :rocket:
Noah (Growth): :thumbsup: locking that. I'll also add the webinar registration with a short qualifying form.
Priya (Solutions): I'll drop compliance logos + SOC2 cert in the shared drive: /shared/marketing/assets/compliance/ and add links to the one-pager.
Sam (Product): Pulling perf numbers now from /shared/benchmarks/2026/latency.csv and /shared/benchmarks/2026/costs.csv — will annotate the benchmark methodology (test harness, baseline config).
Rita (Field): Quick ask: can the one-pager include a 1-line AE play for each deploy mode? Field needs scripts.
Alex (Marketing): Yes — short 1-line plays per mode. Also keeping the hero stat experimental: if infra says numbers look volatile we might soften to 'up to ~40%'. We'll note methodology.
Rita (Field): Perfect. Thanks team — will prep a sample AE slack snippet after draft.
Alex (Marketing): Great. If anyone hits blockers, ping me or drop in #launch-war-room. Thanks all.
